unavailable: Sign-in is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle_one: Staff access for {{domain}} and {{count}} other brand.
signIn.subtitle_other: Staff access for {{domain}} and {{count}} other brands.
signIn.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
signIn.twoFactorRequired: Two-factor is required on this install.
signIn.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.

magicLink.title: Check your email
magicLink.subtitle: If {{email}} belongs to a staff account, a sign-in link is on its way.
magicLink.resent: Another link is on its way.

totp.title: Enter your code
totp.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {{email}}.
totp.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor.
totp.recoveryMismatch: That recovery code is not valid, or it has already been used.
totp.mismatch_one: That code didn't match. {{count}} attempt left before a 15-minute lock.
totp.mismatch_other: That code didn't match. {{count}} attempts left before a 15-minute lock.
totp.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
totp.expired: That sign-in attempt expired. Start again.

noAccount: That account cannot sign in here. Ask an administrator to invite you.

completing.title: Signing you in
completing.body: One moment while this sign-in link is checked.
completing.failed: That sign-in link has expired or has already been used.

passwordReset.sentSubtitle: If {{email}} belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way.
passwordReset.resent: Another link is on its way.
passwordReset.title: Choose a new password
passwordReset.subtitle: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
passwordReset.invalid: That reset link has expired or has already been used.
passwordReset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with it.

enrolment.title: Two-factor setup is required
enrolment.subtitle: This install requires an authenticator app for every staff account.
enrolment.body: The setup screen arrives with the staff milestone (M0-06). Until then, ask an administrator to turn the requirement off or to enrol this account.
